sections.value: ROUND 2 / FINAL performance review: PASS-WITH-NOTES, no new blocking performance finding. Exact detached head 8c31b168a8cc8f92e09ce768c9dde443597e196f verified. Inspected full f808581..8c31b16 delta and the unchanged refusal-formatting callsite. Runtime delta is confined to trust.rs: Claude now performs a heading-position search over the already-captured visible rows, retaining O(visible-screen rows/bytes) work per active waiting spawn; no additional capture, subprocess, IO, resident task, timer, poll, cache or per-registered-seat work. safe_answer now creates bounded guidance Strings from fixed menu labels and a highlighted-row index; its production callsite is trust_prompt_refusal (http/mod.rs:2011-2023), executed when building the terminal no-opt-in refusal, not every opt-in polling tick. The existing 50ms spawn poll, default 30s wait, one reused capture per tick and at-most-one send-keys attempt per second per opted-in prompted wait are unchanged. No new launch site, so the existing counted tmux.send-keys/program::launch path and spawn_sites.rs coverage remain applicable. Close path is unchanged in R2. Tests/docs changes add no production cost. This is source-derived delta review, not fresh runtime measurement: R1 baseline receipt is performance/outputs/2026-11/19-verdict-pr-264-f808581.dd.json (commit 3ea2da53ba352d83de9104a992c5b4871fc40c0f), daemon pid17600 commit dba0c0803b, all counters 552->552 over21s, machine159.7 launches/s, RSS161008->164896KiB. Post-deploy comparison and live trust-key pacing remain explicitly owed; no PR before/after improvement is claimed. No builds, tests, daemon restart or pane input performed; CI-green and mutation results are parent-supplied evidence. Heading/short-pane detection correctness belongs to the correctness review, not a new performance finding.
